purpose: Independent source-faithful phase-reconstruction calibration using ERA5 hourly 2 m temperature, matching the environmental dataset family described by van Toor et al. (2021), without altering the failed registered ERA5-Land calibration.

replicate_environment_source.daily_aggregation: arithmetic mean of exactly 24 finite GMT hourly values computed inside PAYOFF-B
replicate_environment_source.role: independent ERA5 replicate reconstruction closer to the environmental dataset family described in the original paper; not claimed byte-identical to the authors' archived CDS extraction

published_environment_contract.TGS_rule: tgs_doy = day of minimum cumulative sum(daily_mean_temperature_c - 5)

spatial_temporal_matching.query_coordinate: original reconstructed staging-event latitude and longitude

primary_disagreement_estimands.warning: Neither quantity is promoted as the true measurement-error SD without additional assumptions.

consecutive_error_dependence.proxy: Pearson correlation of ERA5-minus-POWER phase discrepancies at origin and destination events of the frozen 224 transitions

lambda_reestimation.power_model: phase_change ~ origin_phase + z_progress + z_endpoint + z_progress:z_endpoint + C(year)
lambda_reestimation.era5_model: same formula after replacing event TGS with ERA5 replicate TGS

null_distribution.latent_predictor_distribution: zero-mean Gaussian on FWL-residualized predictor scale
null_distribution.process_noise_sd: sample SD of frozen full-224 POWER controller residuals
null_distribution.measurement_error_distribution: bivariate Gaussian with scenario-specific equal marginal SD and frozen error correlation
null_distribution.tail_probability: P(lambda_hat <= observed source-faithful POWER lambda_hat) with plus-one correction

licensed_if_completed: event-level disagreement between source-faithful POWER and ERA5 reconstructions
same-subset POWER versus ERA5 lambda comparison
measurement-error sensitivity under frozen replicate-error assumptions
not_licensed: calling the old ERA5-Land calibration a pass
claiming Open-Meteo ERA5 is byte-identical to the original authors' CDS files
promoting a SIMEX or EIV value as the true latent biological lambda
changing the Aikens preregistration or opening the Aikens outcome
